//: Add this block to the 'platforms' array of your Homebridge config.json.
//install: 1) Install the plugin: homebridge-camera-ffmpeg. 2) Replace <CameraName> with the RTSP path avent-login.py printed. 3) Set videoProcessor to the ffmpeg built by build-ffmpeg-fdk.sh (needed for audio). 4) Restart Homebridge, then add the camera manually in the Home app (see README).
name: Camera FFmpeg
//videoProcessor: Absolute path to the libfdk_aac-enabled ffmpeg (from build-ffmpeg-fdk.sh). Only needed for audio; omit to use the system ffmpeg for video-only.

cameras.name: Baby Camera
cameras.//unbridge: REQUIRED. HomeKit cannot bridge cameras; this publishes it as a separate accessory you add manually in the Home app.

videoConfig.//vcodec: Re-encode (do NOT use 'copy'): it conceals the source's occasional corrupt slices and emits regular keyframes, which stops the freezing. -realtime/-bf 0 keep A/V latency low.
